briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google DeepMind accelerate frontier model releases as race intensifies

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race has entered a new phase of rapid iteration with multiple labs shipping advanced reasoning models. Compute constraints and safety concerns are shaping deployment strategies across the industry.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic's Claude 4 and Google's Gemini 3.0 are in closed beta, while Meta open-sourced Llama 4 with improved long-context handling.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent and automotive applications.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra clusters shipping to xAI and Microsoft. New data center builds in Texas and Arizona are adding 50k H100-equivalent GPUs this quarter.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI system emerge from a US lab or a Chinese national project by 2028?
